{{Quote|Groodo, we experienced an interesting event earlier today ... Some Jedi destroyed a most unusual derelict starship."<br />"WHAT?! Destroyed?!"<br />"Yes, that's right. I'd like to tell you all about it, but this line may not be secure. I was hoping you might be able to come to Fondor ... We must have a bad connection. I suggest you come to Fondor at once ... I think you should know there's still a chance we can fulfill our business arrangement. It might be a good idea if you brought some of your special droids with you."<br />"Droids? How many?"<br />"As many as you can.|Senator Rodd of Fondor informs Groodo of the destruction by the Jedi of the Hutt's counterfeit ''Sun Runner'', and advises him to prepare an appropriate counter-response in order to preserve their lucrative business agreement|<ref name=":1">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], one year before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] created a '''copy''' of the ancient [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the ''[[Sun Runner]]'' in a scheme to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. The counterfeit derelict was powered by a [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]], fitted with a contemporary [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammer]], and armed with 20 [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] sensor-[[Guided missile/Legends|guided missiles]] and state-of-the-art [[Trang Robotics]] [[Duelist Elite/Legends|Duelist Elite]] [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]] with [[flexisteel]] [[saber]]s and [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulators]]. Additionally, controlling the ship was a dome-headed, black [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1 astromech]] ([[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]) guarded by three [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[501-Z police droid|501-Z security droids]] heavily armed with new [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[B-20 blaster rifle]]s with pressure-wiped stocks.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref><ref name=":1" />

Professing he believed the derelict to be genuine, but having only seen, he said, its façade, [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]], who claimed [[Salvage hauler|salvage]] rights to the drifting vessel, stated that he wished to transform it into an amusement center—a kind of orbital museum of interstellar travel (while, in fact, he was in secret collusion with Groodo). Alternately, [[Nallastia]]'s [[Margravine]], [[Quenelle]], as the direct descendant of the [[Margrave Octan]], claimed full property ownership of what she, too, believed, by all outward appearances, to be authentic. She accused Rodd of secretly harboring the belief that the vessel contained—though she assured him he was mistaken—the fabled [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]].<ref name=":0" />

When the derelict ship fired upon the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic diplomatic cruiser]] ''[[Unitive]]'', however, it was counterattacked and destroyed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]-[[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] team of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The counterfeit ship's advanced power source, navigational equipment, and armaments provided evidence that this inexact replica did not originate from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of the galaxy, as was previously thought. The false ''Sun Runner'' was at last destroyed by Skywalker when the 18-year-old Jedi planted a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] on the vessel's [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]] and demolished its sensor-[[Guided missile/Legends|guided missile]] silo with the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion-missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launcher]] of a [[Rodd|borrowed]] [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]].<ref name=":0" />

Arriving back on Fondor, Rodd openly accused Kenobi of having destroyed what the Senator claimed to have been the real ''Sun Runner'' in a desperate attempt to resolve the dispute with Nallastia and prevent a Fondorian civil war. But Kenobi reaffirmed the ship's contemporary internal build and cutting-edge accoutrements, estimating its construction to have been within the previous four years and suggesting that Rodd consult with the crew of the [[Fondor Space Patrol]] ship that had been recovered from the derelict, and ask them what they saw. The Senator could only accuse Kenobi again by suggesting that he had employed Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]] to compel the crew to tell Rodd only what the Jedi wanted him to believe, leaving them even less reliable as witnesses than the memory-wiped droids that were on board the ''Sun Runner''. It was then that Obi-Wan realized that he hadn't told Rodd that the transport's droids were memory-wiped, although it was something Anakin had, in fact, discovered when he was aboard the derelict.<ref name=":1" />
